question: SATAT initiative seen in news in November 2024 is related to which union ministry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **SATAT initiative** (Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation) is spearheaded by the **Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas**.

• It was launched in **October 2018** to promote the use of **Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG)** as a clean and affordable alternative fuel for transportation.

• The objective of the initiative is to boost the production of **Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG)** from various waste and biomass sources like agricultural residue, municipal solid waste, sugarcane press mud, and cattle dung.

• SATAT is aimed at reducing dependency on **fossil fuels**, addressing environmental concerns, and increasing farmer income by utilizing agricultural residue.

• The initiative also supports the government's vision of a **"Swachh Bharat" (Clean India)** by addressing the issue of organic waste management effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG):**

• CBG is a purified version of biogas, which has properties similar to compressed natural gas (**CNG**).

• It can be used as a fuel for vehicles and has a calorific value of approximately 52,000 KJ/kg.

• CBG is produced through the **anaerobic digestion** of biomass and waste materials, ensuring efficient waste utilization.

• CBG can be transported through cylinders or pipelines and used for cooking, industrial purposes, and as automotive fuel.

• **Benefits of SATAT Initiative:**

• It helps in reducing **carbon emissions** by replacing fossil fuels with a cleaner alternative.

• Promotes effective **waste management** by utilizing organic waste for energy production.

• Creates job opportunities in rural areas, especially in the collection and processing of biomass.

• Enhances **energy security** by reducing dependency on imported crude oil.

• **Stakeholders Involved:**

• Public sector oil marketing companies (OMCs) like **Indian Oil Corporation (IOC), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL), and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL)** are key players in implementing the SATAT initiative.

• Private sector participation is encouraged to set up **CBG production plants** and supply chains.

• **Government Goals:**

• The SATAT initiative aligns with India’s target of achieving **Net Zero emissions by 2070**.

• The government aims to establish **5,000 CBG plants** across the country by 2025, with a production capacity of 15 million metric tonnes annually.

• It contributes to achieving the goals of the **National Policy on Biofuels**, which emphasizes the production of alternative fuels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Other Ministries:**

• **Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs:** Focuses on urban development schemes like Smart Cities Mission and Swachh Bharat Mission.

• **Ministry of Urban Development:** Now merged with the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs.

• **Ministry of Home Affairs:** Handles internal security, disaster management, and law enforcement.

• **Achievements of SATAT:**

• Several CBG production plants have been commissioned under SATAT, generating employment and contributing to cleaner energy.

• The initiative has garnered interest from private players, leading to investments in bio-energy infrastructure.
